title: WeShop and Parity Bring Shopping-Powered Ownership to Professional Women Athletes and Their Fans
summary: The post WeShop and Parity Bring Shopping-Powered Ownership to Professional Women Athletes and Their Fans appeared first on WeShop .
body_markdown:
NEW YORK, November 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Shop. Stock up. Build your future. WeShop


Holdings Limited (“WeShop” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: WSHP), the community-owned shopping
platform that turns everyday purchases into ownership, today announced a strategic partnership with
Parity, the premier platform for professional women athlete partnerships. As the Official Shopping
Rewards Partner of the Parity community, WeShop will introduce its shopping platform and ShareBackTM
rewards program to professional women athletes and their network across the U.S. Through the
partnership, WeShop will be introduced to Parity’s broader community of more than 1,600 professional
women athletes, including more than 300 Olympians and Paralympians.


According to Parity’s 2024 groundbreaking research, “Beyond the Game: Exposing the Economic
Realities of Pro Women Athletes,” half of the 500 professional women athletes surveyed reported zero
or negative earnings from their sport after expenses, while 64% said they sometimes or frequently
consider getting out of professional sports due to financial implications. By introducing professional
women athletes to WeShop’s ownership-based rewards model, the partnership creates another
opportunity for them to engage with commercial partnerships and share a new shopping experience
with their communities. Parity athletes will share how they shop and discover products on WeShop with
their fans and followers, introducing the platform to the highly engaged women’s sports audience.
“Women athletes earn trust through discipline, performance and showing up for their communities,”
said Maria Weaver, CEO of WeShop. “WeShop is built on the belief that the people who help a platform
grow should have the opportunity to share in its ownership. Working with Parity gives us a meaningful
way to introduce that model to professional women athletes and their fans.”
The initial group of WeShop athlete ambassadors will include Amber Balcaen, trailblazing racecar driver;
Lauren Brzozowski, US National Team bobsled pilot; and Lois Cook, pro tackle football and flag football
player. Through the partnership, these women will share their experiences with WeShop and introduce
the platform to their respective communities.


“Creating more opportunity for women athletes means recognizing the significant influence they have
beyond their sport,” said Leela Srinivasan, CEO of Parity. “Our athletes are entrepreneurs, parents,
creators and trusted voices in their communities. This partnership with WeShop gives them an
opportunity to explore a different kind of shopping rewards model and share it with their audiences.”
While the partnership begins within Parity’s professional athlete community, its reach extends to the
consumers and communities athletes connect with every day. From fellow athletes and families to
shoppers interested in getting more from their everyday purchases, the collaboration creates an
opportunity to build awareness of WeShop’s ownership-based rewards model among a wider audience
through trusted voices and existing communities.


“Opportunities to build equity are still relatively rare for professional women athletes, but WeShop’s
innovative model allows every consumer to earn shares with each purchase,” said Amber Balcaen. “I’m
looking forward to shopping for the brands I already love while owning a piece of the platform.”
WeShop is now available in the U.S. on the App Store and Google Play. To learn more about WeShop
and ShareBack rewards, visit[https://we.shop](https://we.shop/) . For more information about Parity, visit
[www.paritynow.com](http://www.paritynow.com/) .


About WeShop
WeShop Holdings Limited (NASDAQ: WSHP) is a community-owned shopping platform that turns
everyday purchases into ownership. Through its proprietary ShareBackTM program, members earn
ShareBackTM rewards, or WePoints, redeemable for shares in WeShop when they shop and refer others
to the platform, giving the people who help grow the company the opportunity to own a piece of it.
With access to hundreds of leading retailers and more than a billion products, WeShop brings shopping,
rewards and ownership together in one experience. By putting consumers at the center, WeShop is
building a community where members are more than shoppers; they are shareholders.


About Parity
Parity is a women’s sports consultancy specializing in professional athlete partnerships. With a mission
to close the gender income and opportunity gap in sports, Parity connects brands with a diverse
network of more than 1,600 pro women athletes across 90 sports, including 300+ Olympians and
Paralympians. Through athlete-led engagements, official community partnerships, women’s sports
consulting, and custom research, Parity helps brands authentically engage the most trusted voices in
sports today. For more information, visit[www.paritynow.com](http://www.paritynow.com/) .
